notes.title: [v0.3.0] Free stuff, new crops & more
notes.content:
[b]NEW UPDATE IS OUT v0.3.0[/b]

[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] Add launch reward, claimable for next 30 days
[*] 5 new crops
[*] 5 new crop shops
[*] 5 new achievements
[*] New great revolution upgrades
[*] Add export stats
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes & changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Change level requirements for crop processors
[*] Fix some game crashing bugs
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: [v0.2.4] Bug fixes & new features
notes.content:
[b]NEW UPDATE IS OUT v.0.2.4[/b]

[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] New daily  quests
[*] New crop processor upgrades
[*] Add minimum levels for invasions
[*] Possiblity to split counter measure amount
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Invasions no longer activate on locked crops
[*] It is no longer possible to roll equipment while already rolling one
[*] Hard daily quests require proper amounts now
[*] Locust swarm invasion is weaker
[*] Proper formatting for various numbers
[*] Equipment context menu properly displays actions
[*] Clicking on crops while special crop is active duration is no longer decremented
[/list]

Don't forget to join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/N84m8JmPTX]Discord[/url]!
